text:
Ravi (AE): Heads-up 10x: NovaBio wants a 90-day on-prem POC (air-gapped). Asking us to remove both the onboarding fee and the monthly platform license during the eval. Thoughts?
Priya (Sales Manager): what's their conversion signal? any signs they'll commit after POC?
Ravi (AE): engineering team liked runtime benchmarks. CTO said theyre likely to sign a 12mo reserved agreement if POC looks clean, but not guaranteed.
Chen (Deal Desk): full waive is rare. We can consider a structured deferral or credit tied to conversion. Need a short commercial rationale in the memo.
Omar (SE): technical impact: on-prem onboarding involves secure install, HSM/KMS setup, and air-gap packaging. We'll need at minimum 12 SE hours for the POC prep and enablement.
Becca (CS): we also require audit logs and limited retention config during POC. I can include up to 6 hours of CS-run training for onboarding if we include deferred fee.
QuoteBot: standard on-prem fees: ONPREM-ONBOARD = $28,000 one-time, ONPREM-MONTHLY = $3,500/mo, SUPPORT-SILVER = $6,500/mo, SUPPORT-BRONZE = $2,200/mo.
Chen (Deal Desk): proposed structure: defer onboarding fee until conversion (90d window). Provide 75% discount on monthly license for the POC months (capped at 3 months). Include Bronze support and 12 SE hours bundled. Require signed MOU and named POC technical contact.
Lena (Finance): deferral ok provided we create a signed acceptance and clear billing trigger. If they don't convert in 90 days post-POC, onboarding becomes due. Finance will code as deferred revenue.
LegalBot: air-gapped deployments trigger the on-prem addendum and SOC attestation checklist. Expect legal turnaround ~8 business days. MOU should reference the addendum.
Priya (Sales Manager): Chen, please draft a short deal memo with these conditions and an approval TTL. Call out that the onboarding fee becomes permanently waived only if they execute a 12mo reserved contract within 60 days after POC completes.
Chen (Deal Desk): will do. One more ask 10x: include conversion discount mechanic: onboarding fee credited to first invoice if they convert.
Ravi (AE): can we get a one-line quote I can paste to the customer now?
Omar (SE): paste-in:```
SKU lines:
- ONPREM-ONBOARD (deferred) x1 \u2014 list $28,000 \u2014 deferred up to 90 days, becomes invoiced if no conversion.
- ONPREM-LICENSE (POC rate) x3 months \u2014 list $3,500/mo \u2014 75% off for POC months
- SUPPORT-BRONZE (included) x2 months \u2014 list $2,200/mo \u2014 included during POC
- SE-ONBOARD-HOURS 12hrs \u2014 included for POC; additional hours billed at standard rates
Notes: MOU, named POC owner, and on-prem addendum required. Onboarding fee credited if customer signs 12mo reserved within 60 days after POC.
```
Becca (CS): I'll prepare the POC runbook (SSO, KMS, rollback) and share with Ravi for customer review.
Lena (Finance): once memo posted, I'll confirm GL mappings and billing triggers.
Chen (Deal Desk): drafting memo now and will post link here when ready.
Ravi (AE): cool. posting to customer after we have memo and runbook. Thanks team.
Priya (Sales Manager): thumbs up ":thumbsup:" when memo live.
Chen (Deal Desk): memo posted -> internal link: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/memos/2080012345
Lena (Finance): reviewed. :white_check_mark:
Omar (SE): standing by for dates and dry-run.
Ravi (AE): closing loop, will update when customer replies.
